story_info.title: Oliver Fox and the Shy Squirrel
story_info.subtitle: Making Friends in Wonderwood Valley
story_info.moral: Helping others can lead to wonderful new friendships.

main_character.name: Oliver Fox
main_character.appearance: Oliver is a slim young fox with bright orange-red fur, a fluffy white-tipped tail, and perky triangular ears. He has clever amber eyes and a playful, confident grin.

supporting_characters.name: Pip Squirrel
supporting_characters.appearance: A small brown squirrel with a bushy tail and bright curious eyes.
supporting_characters.role: Feels shy and needs help finding nuts in a new place.

cover.visual_action: Oliver Fox and Pip Squirrel find nuts together

slides.title: A Sunny Morning
slides.text: The sun shone bright in Sunny Forest. Oliver Fox walked with a happy hop. His bright orange fur looked extra shiny. He loved exploring new paths. Oliver wagged his fluffy white-tipped tail. He heard birds sing sweet songs. What a lovely morning it was for making friends!
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver Fox explores Sunny Forest on a cheerful morning.

slides.title: A New Friend Appears
slides.text: Oliver spotted something small. It was a little brown squirrel. The squirrel sat under a big oak tree. He looked a bit shy. His bushy tail was not fluffy. He looked down at his paws. Oliver had not seen him before. "Hello there!" Oliver called out with a friendly wave.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver sees a shy squirrel, Pip, for the first time.

slides.title: Pip Needs Help
slides.text: The squirrel looked up. "Hello," he said softly. "My name is Pip. I am new here." Pip looked sad. "I cannot find any nuts," he told Oliver. "My tummy is rumbling a little. I miss my old home. I don't know where to look." Oliver felt a little sad for Pip.
slides.speaker_notes: Pip Squirrel explains his problem to Oliver.

slides.title: Let's Solve It Together!
slides.text: Oliver thought hard. His clever amber eyes sparkled. "Don't worry, Pip!" Oliver said with a confident grin. "I know just the place for nuts. Let's solve it together!" Oliver remembered a big hazelnut bush. It was a little hidden, but full of tasty treats. He knew the way well.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver uses his cleverness and remembers a solution for Pip.

slides.title: Happy New Friends
slides.text: Oliver led Pip to the hazelnut bush. Soon, Pip found many nuts! He nibbled one happily. "Thank you, Oliver!" Pip said with a big smile. Oliver felt warm and happy inside. He made a new friend today. Friendships make every day brighter and more fun! They waved goodbye.
slides.speaker_notes: Oliver and Pip become friends after finding nuts, ending with a warm feeling.

youtube.title: Oliver Fox and the Shy Squirrel | Children's Story About Making Friends
youtube.description: Welcome to Wonderwood Valley! In this fun adventure, Oliver Fox meets a shy new squirrel named Pip. Pip is new to Sunny Forest and can't find any nuts. Can Oliver use his cleverness and friendly spirit to help Pip and make a new friend? Watch to find out! This heartwarming story is perfect for children aged 3-6 years, teaching them about friendship and kindness. Enjoy this educational and engaging tale from our award-winning series.
